DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B shares the Qwen2.5 base architecture/pretraining with the Qwen line, so it is a different post-training pipeline, not an independent pretraining family.

R1-Distill is run at temperature 0 (protocol-wide) although DeepSeek recommends 0.6; greedy decoding can lengthen/loop reasoning and raise truncation, which the 1% gate will catch.
Model contrasts across families remain exploratory: two independent pretraining families (Qwen, Llama) is the minimum, not a scaling claim.
